# BM International

BM International is a leading B2B garments sourcing agency and textile exporter based in Karachi, Pakistan. Founded by Muhammad Moeen Baig, the company connects global retail brands, apparel wholesalers, and institutional buyers with certified textile manufacturers in Pakistan. BM International manages the entire supply chain, including supplier vetting, custom sample development, bulk production oversight, on-ground AQL quality inspections, customs clearance, and global shipping.

## Core Sourcing Offerings & Sections

- **Homepage**: https://bminternational.com.pk/ - Overview of buying agency services, quality standards, and client testimonials.
- **Sourcing Services**: https://bminternational.com.pk/#services - End-to-end B2B services: custom garments manufacturing, fresh production stock lots, cancelled shipment stock procurement, and local agency representation.
- **Product Catalog**: https://bminternational.com.pk/#products - Sourcing categories:
  - *Apparel*: Flannel shirts & jackets, fleece knitwear, denim & jeans, hoodies & sweatshirts, trousers & bottoms, sportswear, sleepwear, and kids' wear.
  - *Accessories*: Baseball caps, snapbacks, beanies, bucket hats, visors, and reusable fabric face masks.
  - *Home Textiles*: Bed sheets, fitted sheets, duvet covers, pillowcases, bath mats, aprons, and towels (bath, hand, kitchen, wash towels).
  - *Rags*: White and multi-color cotton industrial cleaning rags (wipers).
- **How We Work (Process)**: https://bminternational.com.pk/#how-we-work - Our 4-step B2B process: Inquiry -> Sourcing & Sampling -> Production & Inspection (AQL 1.5/2.5) -> Shipment & Payment.
- **Frequently Asked Questions**: https://bminternational.com.pk/#faq - Quick B2B specifications, MOQs, sample lead times, and audit details.
- **B2B Sourcing Blogs & Resources**: https://bminternational.com.pk/blogs/ - 59 articles on garment specifications, quality checks, cotton sourcing guides, and import regulations.

## Quality Standards & Compliance

- **Inspections**: 100% on-ground inspections in Pakistan under AQL 1.5 (major) and 2.5 (minor) standards.
- **Certifications**: GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard), OCS (Organic Content Standard), and BCI (Better Cotton Initiative) cotton.
